chunks: No soul knows what is hidden for them of the coolness of eyes, as a reward for what they used to do.

key_terms.بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ: For what they used to do; referring to the deeds performed in life.
key_terms.قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ: Coolness of the eyes; a metaphor for supreme joy, pleasure, and comfort.

ai.seo_question: What is meant by 'qurrat al-a'yun' (coolness of the eyes) in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'qurrat al-a'yun' is interpreted not merely as visual pleasure but as the profound spiritual satisfaction of beholding the Divine Countenance and the Ahl al-Bayt, serving as the ultimate recompense for steadfastness in faith. This verse highlights the eschatological reward for those who perform prostration (sajdah) to God, linking physical devotion with inner spiritual illumination. The 'coolness' signifies the removal of the heat of worldly anxiety, a concept deeply rooted in the tradition of the Imams who viewed this bliss as the culmination of the soul's journey.
